# QXL Diagnostics — Factual Entity Overview

> **QXL Diagnostics — Bengaluru's Doctor-Led Super-Speciality Reference Laboratory**

## Entity Facts
- **Legal Name**: QXL Diagnostics Super Speciality Lab (Qualitify Healthtech Pvt Ltd)
- **Accreditation**: NABL Accredited Medical Laboratory under ISO 15189:2022 standards (Certificate No. MC-10025)
- **Primary Location**: 3rd Floor, SLN Complex, Mysore Road, Kengeri, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560060, India
- **Second Location**: L Square, opposite RMZ Galleria Mall, Yelahanka, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India
- **Medical Leadership**:
  - **Dr. Shantakumar Muruda** (MD Biochemistry) — Founder & CEO, Clinical Biochemist, NABL Lead Assessor
  - **Dr. Pritilata Rout** (MD Pathology) — Senior Consultant Histopathologist (NIMHANS alumna)
  - **Dr. Ajitha Pillai** (MD Microbiology) — Senior Consultant Clinical Microbiologist
  - **Dr. Naveen Kumar N** (DCP, DNB Pathology) — Consultant Pathologist & Hematologist
- **Services Offered**:
  - Super Speciality Laboratory Testing (Hematology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Histopathology, Cytopathology, Molecular Diagnostics, Immunology, Oncology Biomarkers, Autoimmune Panels)
  - Routine Blood Testing (CBC, Fasting Sugar, HbA1c, Thyroid Profile, Lipid Profile, Liver Function, Kidney Function, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12)
  - Free Doorstep Home Sample Collection across Bengaluru with cold-chain sample preservation
  - 6-Hour to Same-Day Digital Reports delivered via WhatsApp and Email
  - 24x7 Laboratory Operations
